title: The rate limiter never refills when it is polled more than once a second
issue: A bucket created with `TokenBucket(rate=2, capacity=2)` should allow two operations per second on average. After the initial burst, a client that calls `allow()` every 250 ms is refused forever: no token is ever added. A client that waits two full seconds between calls does get tokens back, so refill works only for long gaps.

steps.say: I'll start with the module the issue is about.
Before changing anything I want to see what the existing tests cover.
_refill truncates the elapsed time to whole seconds and then records the current time, so fractions of a second are discarded on every call.
Running the tests again to confirm nothing that worked before is broken.

args.summary: The elapsed time is no longer truncated to whole seconds, so partial seconds accumulate into tokens.
